answer: Each device's sensors carry a unique noise signature from manufacturing imperfections. The agent samples its accelerometer and gyroscope noise, hashes the pattern, and submits it at registration. The pattern is framed in timber-solid hardware: it is measured from physical sensors, not invented by software. A nebula of possible patterns makes each one distinct, and an umber marker flags any duplicate. Forging a sensor signature means building new hardware, not writing a script.
